meaning:
ἀντ-εῖπον
(άντί, εἶτον), [in LXX for H7725 hi., דָבַר pi., עָנָה, etc. ;]
2 2 aor., without present in use, to speak against, gainsay: Luk.21:15, Act.4:14.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
